# Pairs of Markdown files for TestEqual, one per line: the name of the pair,
# whose files are NAME.a.md and NAME.b.md, "equal" or "different", and the
# reason. An equal pair renders equal test HTML, and a different pair renders
# different test HTML (design 10.5).
block-quote-blank-line different CM 242 is two block quotes, and CM 244 is one
block-quote-lazy-line equal a lazy line continues the paragraph (CM 233)
code-blank-line-inside different a blank line inside code is content (CM 111)
code-blank-line-after equal trailing blank lines are not code (CM 117)
code-end-of-input equal the last code line gets a line feed (design 8.2)
html-end-of-input equal the last HTML line gets a line feed (design 8.2)
fenced-and-indented-code equal code has no fenced key (design 8.2)
math-fence-info different GitHub renders a math fence as math (design 9.1)
list-start different the start number is in the list key (design 10.2)
list-bullet equal the bullet character is not in the list key (design 10.2)
list-delimiter equal the ordered delimiter is not in the list key (design 10.2)
list-looseness different a blank line between items makes the list loose (CM 314)
line-ending-kind equal the kind of line ending is not meaning (product rule 7)
heading-style equal the key of a heading is its level (design 10.2)
heading-level different the key of a heading is its level (design 10.2)
thematic-break-marker equal a thematic break has no key (design 10.2)
blank-line-count equal blank lines between blocks are syntax (design 4.2)
definition-label-case equal the key of a definition is its normalized label (CM 205)
html-block-blank-line different a blank line ends an HTML block of kind 6 (CM 148)
hard-break-form equal two spaces and a backslash give the same hard break (CM 633, 634)
trailing-space equal spaces before a soft break or at the end of a paragraph are not content (CM 226, 649)
escape equal an escaped character is the character (CM 12)
replacement-character equal NUL and invalid UTF-8 are U+FFFD (design 6.7, 8.4)
code-replacement-character equal NUL and invalid UTF-8 in code and HTML blocks are U+FFFD (design 8.4)
entity-reference equal an entity or numeric character reference is its characters (CM 25, 26, 27)
definition-escape equal escapes and entity references in a destination and a title are their characters (CM 23, 33)
info-string-escape equal escapes and entity references in an info string are their characters (CM 24, 34)
code-span-padding equal one space at each end of a code span is not content (CM 329)
code-span-one-space different a space at only one end of a code span is content (CM 332)
code-span-fence equal the length of the backtick runs of a code span is not content (CM 339)
code-span-line-ending equal a line ending in a code span is a space (CM 335)
autolink-entity equal cmark decodes entity references in an autolink (design 8.4)
autolink-escape different a backslash in an autolink is not an escape (CM 603)
raw-html-escaped different raw HTML is not text (CM 613)
raw-html-indent equal the indentation of a paragraph line in raw HTML is not content (CM 615, 616)
emphasis-character equal the delimiter character is not in the key of emphasis (CM 350, 357, 378, 382)
emphasis-nesting different emphasis around strong emphasis is not strong emphasis around emphasis (CM 467)
link-title-quote equal the quotes of a title are not content (CM 505)
link-destination-angle equal the angle brackets of a destination are not content (CM 492, 580)
link-tail-line-ending equal whitespace in a link tail is not content (CM 510)
reference-label-case equal a reference label matches after case folding (CM 539)
strikethrough-tilde-count equal the number of tildes of strikethrough is not in its key (GFM 491, cmark-gfm extensions 17)
table-pipes equal the leading and trailing pipes of table rows are not content (GFM 199)
table-padding equal spaces around the content of a table cell are not content (GFM 198)
table-short-row equal a missing table cell is an empty cell (GFM 204, design 10.3)
table-alignment different the delimiter row gives each column its alignment (GFM 199)
cell-pipe-escape-backslash equal a backslash before an escaped pipe in a table cell is removed with the pipe's backslash (cmark-gfm extensions 11)
cell-pipe-split-paragraph different the paragraph split off above a table gets the cell pipe rule (testdata/dialect.md)
task-box-case equal x and X both check a task box (GitHub fixture tasks/basic)
task-box-whitespace equal the spaces and tabs after a task box are not content (GitHub fixture tasks/whitespace)
task-checked different a task is checked or not (cmark-gfm extensions 28)
footnote-reference-label-case equal a footnote reference label matches after case folding (GitHub fixture footnotes/label-case)
footnote-definition-label-case different GitHub writes the label of a definition as written into element ids (design 9.2)
dialect-search-blank-line different a blank line before an HTML block named search ends the paragraph that GitHub continues (github 17)
